caption_L1: This line plot is titled Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of the federal state of Delaware from 2000 to 2019 (in billion U.S. dollars). On the x-axis, Year is defined. The y-axis plots Real GDP in billion U.S. dollars.
caption_L2L3: Overall the GDP of Delaware has increased from around $55 billion in the year 2000 to over $60 billion in 2015. Generally the increase in GDP saw some small rises and dips over the 15 year period. The largest dip was in 2012 followed by the steepest rise in 2013-2015.
